title: 第4章 牛有道（庆百盟，加更）
slug: 道君全本免费-道君最新章节列表
content_zh:
罗元功双手接了掌门令牌，表达了该有的尊敬，归位时看向唐素素和苏破，忍不住叹了声。
没办法，此时的唐牧压根不惧任何压力，就算联合宗门上下所有人反对也没用，指定掌门继承人是门规赋予掌门的权力，唐牧临死前非要这样玩，谁玩的赢他？
“诸位谨记，我死之后，秘不发丧，否则易给上清宗惹来大祸！”唐牧又当众颁下一道遗命。
众人面面相觑，不知是什么意思？几位长老眼神碰了下，都有忧色，似乎察觉到了什么。
稍候，其他内门弟子散去，厅内只剩三位长老，还有唐仪和魏多。
此时长老罗元功才沉声问道：“掌门，你和东郭浩然先后率领座下弟子离去，如今你又伤成这样而归，究竟出了什么事，是谁打伤的你？”
唐牧硬挺在那平静道：“我精力不济，有什么疑问等师弟接掌掌门之位后，你们再问他吧。”
唐素素寒着脸道：“最近外面有传言，说什么商镜重现天下，难道掌门和东郭浩然是因与人抢夺商镜而弄成这样？”
提到‘商镜’这东西，在场诸人神色皆动容，紧盯唐牧的反应。
实在是‘商镜’这玩意的来头太大，如今天下虽是七雄并立，但说到底还是武国的底子上来的。当年修行界第一高手商颂本可逍遥一生，后不知怎么心血来潮突然掺和进了俗事，费尽心力一统天下，建立了武国，自己也当了武国皇帝，一直压制着天下修士，美其名曰避免修士与凡人争利。后来商颂为了求长生，有违初衷，将天给捅了一个窟窿，造成灵气大量从天外泄入，令修行界想不繁荣起来都难。商颂的夫人也就是武国的王后离歌，不忘初衷，因此补天，结果夫妇二人双双不知去向。
夫妇二人消失后，分封天下的数百个诸侯国再也无人能压制的住，诸侯开启了战乱，一直持续至今。
传说商颂炼制了一套法宝，共八件，商颂破天和离歌补天都是凭借此宝。武国崩盘，神器外流，八件宝物也在诸侯国之间流转不停。随着小国不断被吞并，天下最终形成八强割据的局面，八件宝物也分别被八国所掌握，被各国视为镇国神器。而这‘商镜’就是秦国手上的镇国神器，传言‘商镜’乃是破天和补天法宝的引子，乃八宝之首，因此引得修士介入，令秦国被灭。秦国国朝崩溃之际，‘商镜’却下落不明，各方势力寻找皆不得其踪。
问题的关键是，传言武国王后离歌补天时并未将天给补全，仍有漏缝。有人因此认为天下修士过多与此有关，修士一多就免不了与民争利，认为修士不断插手俗事令天下战乱不断，于是有人想集齐八件法宝补全天之漏洞，断绝灵气来源，如此一来自然就得罪了天下修士，燕国大司马宁王商建伯就是此中代表。
偏偏上清宗有不肖弟子和宁王商建伯眉来眼去，譬如东郭浩然。
最近外界突然风传‘商镜’重现天日，唐牧和东郭浩然又在这个时候带着弟子跑出去不知道干什么去了，还闹成这样，想不让人怀疑二人的行踪和商镜有关都难。
一国的背后站着多少修行门派？而商镜却是能引来灭国之祸的东西，试问若是上清宗招惹上了这东西的话，能不让人担心吗？上清宗已非早年兴盛时期的上清宗，早已式微，经不起狂风暴雨。
唐牧缓缓闭眼，“你们想多了，只因遭不明身份的人偷袭而已。”
几人算是看出来了，唐牧压根不想说出真相，他这个样子，随时会倒下，谁也没办法逼他……
次日天明，庙门嘎吱开出一条缝，一只眼睛在门缝内往外溜了几眼。
门缝渐渐门再开，道爷探脚轻轻侧出身子，踮着脚尖轻悄悄落步，不敢发出声响，继续观察着外面的动静。出到外面绕着小庙转了圈，竖着耳朵听，睁着眼睛看，小心观察着四周。

似乎隆冬季节，外面天寒地冻，草木枯黄。
到处扔了几块石头探路，也不见什么反应，发现好像真没什么危险后，庙外站在山坡上的道爷方放松挺直了因保持警惕而猫着的身板，再次从怀里摸出了那只镜面打磨的光可鉴人的铜镜，唉声叹气地对着自己的脸左右照了照。

content_en:
Luo Yuangong took the leader's token with both hands and expressed the due respect. When he returned to his position, he looked at Tang Susu and Su Po and couldn't help but sigh.
There was no way. At this time, Tang Mu was not afraid of any pressure at all. Even if he united with everyone in the sect to oppose it, it would be useless. Designating the heir to the head was the power given to the head by the sect rules. Tang Mu insisted on doing this before he died. Who could beat him?
"Everyone, please remember that after my death, the funeral will not be announced secretly, otherwise it will easily bring disaster to the Shangqing Sect!" Tang Mu issued another will in public.
Everyone looked at each other, wondering what it meant? Several elders looked at each other with worried looks, as if they had noticed something.
After a while, the other inner disciples dispersed, leaving only three elders, Tang Yi and Wei Duo in the hall.
At this time, the elder Luo Yuangong asked in a deep voice: "Master, you and Dong Guo Haoran led the disciples to leave one after another. Now you have returned with such an injury. What happened? Who injured you?"
Tang Mu stood firm and said calmly: "I'm not energetic enough. If you have any questions, you can ask him after your junior brother takes over the position of head."
Tang Su Suhan said with a face: "Recently there are rumors outside that Shang Jing has reappeared in the world. Could it be that the leader and Dong Guo Haoran caused this to happen because they robbed Shang Jing?"
When the word 'Shang Jing' was mentioned, everyone present looked moved and stared closely at Tang Mu's reaction.
It is true that the background of 'Shang Jing' is too big. Although there are seven heroes standing side by side in the world now, in the final analysis, they still come from the foundation of the Wu Kingdom. At that time, Shang Song, the top master in the spiritual world, could have lived a happy life, but then he suddenly got involved in secular affairs on a whim. He worked hard to unify the world and established the Wu Kingdom. He also became the emperor of the Wu Kingdom. He has been suppressing the monks in the world, and the euphemistic reason is to prevent the monks from competing with mortals for profit. Later, in order to seek immortality, Shang Song went against his original intention and dug a hole in the sky, causing a large amount of spiritual energy to leak in from the sky, making it difficult for the spiritual world to prosper. Shang Song's wife, Li Ge, the queen of Wu Kingdom, did not forget her original intention and repaired the sky. As a result, the couple disappeared without a trace.
After the couple disappeared, no one could suppress the hundreds of vassal states that divided the world, and the vassals started a war that continues to this day.
Legend has it that Shang Song refined a set of eight magic weapons, which were used by Shang Song to break the sky and Li Ge to mend the sky. The Wu Kingdom collapsed, the artifacts were leaked out, and the eight treasures were constantly circulating among the vassal states. As small countries continued to be annexed, the world eventually became divided into eight powerful countries. The eight treasures were also mastered by the eight countries, and were regarded by each country as an artifact to protect the country. And this 'Shang Mirror' is the sacred weapon of the Qin State that controls the country. It is rumored that the 'Shang Mirror' is the introduction to the magic weapon of breaking the sky and repairing the sky, and is the first of the eight treasures. Therefore, it attracted the monks to intervene and the Qin State was destroyed. When the Qin Dynasty collapsed, the whereabouts of 'Shang Jing' were unknown, and all forces could not find it.
The key to the problem is that it is rumored that Queen Wu Lige did not mend the sky when she repaired it, and there were still gaps. Some people therefore believe that the excessive number of monks in the world is related to this. If there are too many monks, they will inevitably compete with the people. They believe that monks continue to interfere in secular affairs and cause constant wars in the world. So some people want to collect eight magic weapons to fill the loopholes in the sky and cut off the source of spiritual energy. This will naturally offend the monks in the world. The great minister of Yan State, King Shang Jianbo, is one of them.
It happened that some unscrupulous disciples of the Shangqing Sect were flirting with Prince Ning Shang Jianbo, such as Dong Guo Haoran.
Recently, the outside world suddenly heard rumors that "Shang Jing" has reappeared. At this time, Tang Mu and Dong Guo Haoran took their disciples and ran out for unknown reasons. They also made such a fuss. It is difficult to avoid people suspecting that their whereabouts are related to Shang Jing.
How many spiritual sects are behind a country? But Shang Jing is something that can cause disaster to the country. If the Shangqing Sect is provoked by this thing, can people not be worried? The Shangqing Sect is no longer the Shangqing Sect that flourished in its early years. It has long since declined and cannot withstand the storm.
Tang Mu slowly closed his eyes, "You guysI thought too much, it was just because I was attacked by unknown people. "
Several people finally saw that Tang Mu didn't want to tell the truth at all. He would fall down at any time like this, and no one could force him...
At dawn the next day, the temple door creaked open, and an eye peeked out a few times.
The door gradually cracked and the door opened again. Master Dao stretched out his feet and leaned out gently, stepping down quietly on tiptoes, not daring to make any sound, and continued to observe the movement outside. I went outside and walked around the small temple, listening with my ears open, looking with my eyes open, and carefully observing the surroundings.
It seems to be the middle of winter, the weather is freezing outside and the grass and trees are withered and yellow.
After throwing a few stones here and there to explore the path, there was no reaction. After discovering that there seemed to be no danger, the Taoist priest who was standing on the hillside outside the temple relaxed and straightened his body that was so vigilant. He once again took out the polished bronze mirror from his arms and looked at his face from side to side with a sigh.
